reviewFindings.sourceRights: OECD data terms require checking dataset-specific and third-party rights; not blanket CC BY 4.0.
reviewFindings.mortality: 44 mortality concepts derive from WHO mortality data; OECD-specific redistribution scope needs clarification against WHO noncommercial raw-data terms.
reviewFindings.education: K means data included in another category (6 missing-value rows); W means includes data from another category (one lower-secondary 2021 value). Separate annual comparability review is necessary.
reviewFindings.versions: Health and Education at a Glance 2026 are available; do not claim the old 2025 selection is the latest release.
reviewFindings.spendingHierarchy: COFOG subfunctions overlap with parent functions. Show them as components, not additive independent outcomes.
reviewFindings.metadataAccess: Successful structural metadata retrieval after explicit SDMX XML Accept header. Reference-metadata requests for COFOG and public finances return HTTP 500; alternate CSV representation also tested.
reviewFindings.endPeriod: The exact legacy candidate queries end in 2025; this verifies those candidates, not completeness of 2026 releases.
reviewFindings.selectedSourceRightsReview: 20 selected OECD/Eurostat national-accounts indicators cleared against OECD Government at a Glance methodology and Eurostat reuse terms. Reference-metadata API failures remain documented; official methodology pages establish the original source and definitions. No WHO-derived mortality series included.
